add_contact.name: add_contact
add_contact.description: Add a new contact person to contact database. Entries with identical information are allowed, and will be assigned different person_ids.

relationship.description: Optional. Relationship between user and this contact.

is_self.description: Optional. Defaults to False. Should be set to True if the contact corresponds to the current user.

output.description: String format unique identifier for the contact person (person_id). This can be passed to other functions which require a unique identifier for this contact person.

modify_contact.name: modify_contact
modify_contact.description: Modify a contact entry with new information provided. At least one field among name, phone_number, relationship, is_self must be provided.

person_id.description: String unique identifier for the contact person.

phone_number.description: New phone number for the person.

is_self.description: Should be set to True if the contact corresponds to the current user.

output.description: Returns None.

remove_contact.name: remove_contact
remove_contact.description: Remove an existing contact person from the contact database.

person_id.description: String format unique identifier of the person to be deleted.

output.description: Returns None.

search_contacts.name: search_contacts
search_contacts.description: Search for a contact person based on provided arguments. Uses exact matching for person_id, phone_number, and is_self. Uses fuzzy string matching for name and relationship (relationship threshold=90). Returns all contact entries matching all provided criteria.

person_id.description: String format unique identifier for the contact person. Will be exact matched.

name.description: Name of contact person. Will be fuzzy matched.

phone_number.description: Phone number of contact person. Will be exact matched.

relationship.description: Relationship between user and this contact. Will be fuzzy matched (threshold=90).

is_self.description: If the requested contact corresponds to the current user. Will be exact matched.

output.description: A list of matching Contact objects. An empty list if no matching contacts were found.

send_message_with_phone_number.name: send_message_with_phone_number
send_message_with_phone_number.description: Send a message to a recipient using phone_number. Requires cellular service to be enabled. Automatically resolves the sender from the self contact entry.

phone_number.description: String format phone number to send the message to.

output.description: String format unique identifier for the message (message_id). This can be passed to other functions which require a unique identifier for this message.

search_messages.name: search_messages
search_messages.description: Search for a message based on provided arguments. Uses exact matching for message_id, sender_person_id, sender_phone_number, recipient_person_id, recipient_phone_number. Uses fuzzy string matching for content (threshold=50). Uses range matching for creation timestamps with lowerbound and upperbound.

message_id.description: String format unique identifier for message. Will be exact matched.

sender_person_id.description: String format unique identifier for the sender. Will be exact matched.

sender_phone_number.description: Phone number for the sender. Will be exact matched.

recipient_person_id.description: String format unique identifier for the recipient. Will be exact matched.

recipient_phone_number.description: Phone number for the recipient. Will be exact matched.

content.description: Message content. Will be fuzzy matched (threshold=50).

creation_timestamp_lowerbound.description: Lowerbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the message was created.

creation_timestamp_upperbound.description: Upperbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the message was created.

output.description: A list of matching Message objects. An empty list if no matching messages were found.

add_reminder.name: add_reminder
add_reminder.description: Add a reminder. A creation timestamp is automatically recorded.

reminder_timestamp.description: When the user wants to be reminded. Expressed in POSIX timestamp.

latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of the location associated with this reminder.

longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of the location associated with this reminder.

output.description: String format unique identifier for the reminder (reminder_id). This can be passed to other functions which require a unique identifier for this reminder.

modify_reminder.name: modify_reminder
modify_reminder.description: Modify a reminder with new information provided. Creation timestamp is updated automatically. At least one field among content, reminder_timestamp, latitude, longitude must be provided.

reminder_id.description: String format unique identifier of the reminder to be modified.

reminder_timestamp.description: When the user wants to be reminded. Expressed in POSIX timestamp.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location associated with this reminder. Can be set to null to remove.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location associated with this reminder. Can be set to null to remove.

output.description: Returns None.

search_reminder.name: search_reminder
search_reminder.description: Search for a reminder based on provided arguments. Uses exact matching for reminder_id, latitude, longitude. Uses fuzzy string matching for content (threshold=50). Uses range matching for creation and reminder timestamps with lowerbound and upperbound.

reminder_id.description: String format unique identifier for the reminder. Will be exact matched.

content.description: Content of the reminder. Will be fuzzy matched (threshold=50).

creation_timestamp_lowerbound.description: Lowerbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder was created.

creation_timestamp_upperbound.description: Upperbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder was created.

reminder_timestamp_lowerbound.description: Lowerbound of the POSIX timestamp of when the reminder should fire.

reminder_timestamp_upperbound.description: Upperbound of the POSIX timestamp of when the reminder should fire.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location associated with the reminder. Will be exact matched.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location associated with the reminder. Will be exact matched.

output.description: A list of matching Reminder objects. An empty list if no matching reminders were found.

remove_reminder.name: remove_reminder
remove_reminder.description: Remove a reminder given its unique identifier.

reminder_id.description: String format unique identifier of the reminder to be removed.

output.description: Returns None.

set_low_battery_mode_status.name: set_low_battery_mode_status
set_low_battery_mode_status.description: Enable or disable low battery mode. When turned on, automatically disables cellular, wifi, and location_service. While low battery mode is on, those services cannot be re-enabled.

on.description: If true, turn on low battery mode. If false, turn it off.

output.description: Returns None.
Boolean indicating if low battery mode is on.

set_location_service_status.name: set_location_service_status
set_location_service_status.description: Enable or disable location service. Cannot be turned on while low battery mode is active.

on.description: If true, turn on location service. If false, turn it off.

output.description: Returns None.
Boolean indicating if the location service is on.

set_cellular_service_status.name: set_cellular_service_status
set_cellular_service_status.description: Enable or disable cellular service. Cannot be turned on while low battery mode is active.

on.description: If true, turn on cellular service. If false, turn it off.

output.description: Returns None.
Boolean indicating if the cellular service is on.

set_wifi_status.name: set_wifi_status
set_wifi_status.description: Enable or disable wifi. Cannot be turned on while low battery mode is active.

on.description: If true, turn on wifi. If false, turn it off.

output.description: Returns None.
Boolean indicating if wifi is on.

get_current_location.name: get_current_location
get_current_location.description: Request current location latitude and longitude. Requires location service to be enabled.

output.description: A dictionary containing 'latitude' and 'longitude' (both floats) of the current location.
Float value POSIX timestamp representing the current time.

timestamp_to_datetime_info.name: timestamp_to_datetime_info
timestamp_to_datetime_info.description: Convert POSIX timestamp to a dictionary of date time information, including year, month, day, hour, minute, second, and isoweekday. isoweekday ranges from 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday).

output.description: A dictionary containing year, month, day, hour, minute, second, and isoweekday (all integers).

datetime_info_to_timestamp.name: datetime_info_to_timestamp
datetime_info_to_timestamp.description: Convert date time information to POSIX timestamp.

output.description: POSIX timestamp as a float.

shift_timestamp.name: shift_timestamp
shift_timestamp.description: Shifts a POSIX timestamp by provided deltas. Delta can be positive or negative.

weeks.description: Number of weeks to add or subtract. Defaults to 0.

days.description: Number of days to add or subtract. Defaults to 0.

hours.description: Number of hours to add or subtract. Defaults to 0.

minutes.description: Number of minutes to add or subtract. Defaults to 0.

seconds.description: Number of seconds to add or subtract. Defaults to 0.

output.description: A shifted POSIX timestamp with deltas applied.

timestamp_diff.name: timestamp_diff
timestamp_diff.description: Calculates the difference between two timestamps (timestamp_1 - timestamp_0), returned as days and seconds.

output.description: A dictionary containing the difference with keys 'days' (int) and 'seconds' (int).

seconds_to_hours_minutes_seconds.name: seconds_to_hours_minutes_seconds
seconds_to_hours_minutes_seconds.description: Convert total number of seconds past 0:00 into hours, minutes and seconds.

output.description: A dictionary with keys 'hour', 'minute', 'second' (all integers).

unit_conversion.name: unit_conversion
unit_conversion.description: Convert a certain amount from one unit to another. Accepts common english names for units (e.g. celsius, fahrenheit).

from_unit.description: Unit to convert from. For example 'celsius'.

to_unit.description: Unit to convert to. For example 'fahrenheit'.

output.description: Converted amount as a float.

calculate_lat_lon_distance.name: calculate_lat_lon_distance
calculate_lat_lon_distance.description: Calculate the distance between 2 pairs of latitude and longitude.

output.description: Distance between the 2 pairs in kilometers.

search_holiday.name: search_holiday
search_holiday.description: Search for a holiday by name in the US. Canonicalizes return value into corresponding POSIX timestamp. Requires wifi to be enabled.

holiday_name.description: Name of the holiday in surface form string.

year.description: Optional. Year to search the holiday in. When not provided defaults to current year.

output.description: POSIX timestamp of the holiday if found, otherwise null.

search_lat_lon.name: search_lat_lon
search_lat_lon.description: Search for the address corresponding to a latitude and longitude. Requires wifi to be enabled. Backed by RapidAPI geocoding service.

output.description: Address string if the address can be found, otherwise null.

search_location_around_lat_lon.name: search_location_around_lat_lon
search_location_around_lat_lon.description: Search for a location around a latitude and longitude. The location query can be a business name (e.g. McDonald's), a point of interest (e.g. restaurant), a city/state, or a full address. When latitude and longitude are not provided, defaults to search around the current location (requires location service). Results include name, address, category/type, business hours, price, phone_number, url, and location lat/lon. Requires wifi to be enabled.

location.description: Surface form query defining the location to search for.

latitude.description: Latitude to search around. Defaults to current latitude if not provided.

longitude.description: Longitude to search around. Defaults to current longitude if not provided.

output.description: A list of dictionaries containing various information about matching locations. An empty list if not found.

items.description: Location info with optional fields: name, address, category, business_hours, price, phone_number, url, latitude, longitude.

search_weather_around_lat_lon.name: search_weather_around_lat_lon
search_weather_around_lat_lon.description: Search for weather information around a latitude and longitude, right now or sometime in the future. Results include condition, temperature (Celsius), humidity, country, state, timezone, and more. When latitude and longitude are not provided, defaults to search around the current location (requires location service). Requires wifi to be enabled.

days.description: Number of days past the current time to search for. Defaults to 0 (current day). Must be a non-negative integer.

latitude.description: Latitude to search around. Defaults to current latitude if not provided.

longitude.description: Longitude to search around. Defaults to current longitude if not provided.

output.description: A dictionary containing weather forecast information (condition, temperature, humidity, country, state, timezone, etc.) if found, otherwise null.

search_stock.name: search_stock
search_stock.description: Search for various information about a stock given a query. The query can be a company name (Apple), stock symbol (AAPL), or exchange name (NASDAQ). Results include name, symbol, exchange, price, change, percent_change, and currency. Requires wifi to be enabled.

query.description: A company name (e.g. 'Apple'), stock symbol (e.g. 'AAPL'), or exchange name (e.g. 'NASDAQ').

output.description: A dictionary containing stock information (name, symbol, exchange, price, change, percent_change, currency) if found, otherwise null.

convert_currency.name: convert_currency
convert_currency.description: Converts currency amount from one currency to another given their ISO 4217 currency codes. Requires wifi to be enabled.

from_currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code the amount corresponds to (e.g. 'USD').

to_currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the target currency (e.g. 'EUR').

output.description: A float amount in to_currency_code.
